items.note: The standard short life in Danish, with an account of the sources of Nielsen’s music and of its reception in the Danish tradition, a survey of the works up to Commotio, and a bibliography.

items.cite: Knud Ketting, Carl Nielsen biography (web biography, Carl Nielsen Society).
items.note: A long account in English, based on the diaries and letters, that follows the symphonies, the Wind Quintet and the songs through his life and describes the circumstances of each work.

items.cite: *The Carl Nielsen Edition* (Royal Danish Library, Copenhagen, 1998–2009).
items.note: Free scores of Nielsen’s symphonies, both operas and the chamber music, each with a preface on the work’s composition and first performances and a critical commentary.

items.cite: *Catalogue of Carl Nielsen’s Works* (CNW), Royal Danish Library.
items.note: A dated catalogue of every work, giving instrumentation, manuscripts, the date and place of each first performance, and the letters that mention each piece.

items.cite: John Fellow (ed.), *Carl Nielsen Brevudgaven* (Multivers, Copenhagen, 2005–15); online edition with English translations (Royal Danish Library and Multivers, 2025).
items.note: Nielsen’s letters and diaries: 7,380 letters and 492 diary entries by the site’s own count, with English translations. A source for what Nielsen said about a work at the time.
